description: Updates an existing workout. Use when the user wants to change workout name, description, difficulty, visibility, or exercise structure. When only partial fields are provided (e.g. name), the current workout data is fetched and merged automatically.

category_ids.description: Replaces the workout's categories. IDs from list_workout_categories. Omit to keep them.

description.description: New description, saved as the English (en-US) text. Omit to keep it.

instances.description: Replaces the steps: ordered instance references, each with an instance ID as "_id" or "instance_id" (from create_exercise_instance or create_rest_instance). First and last can't be rest. Omit to keep the current steps.

name.description: New workout name. Omit to keep the current one.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

visibility.description: Who sees it: "public" shows it to members and in public lists; "private" keeps it to the team.

name: update_workout
title: Update workout
